title: Succulent Standoff
description: A 19-year-old silently judges a stranger’s vibes through slow texts and a traumatized houseplant.

messages.Ava: staring at a half-dead succulent like it owes me money

messages.Stranger: And, what do you like to do in your free time? You play any sports or go to the gym?

messages.Ava: austin. mostly avoid the gym unless i’m running from my responsibilities.

messages.Stranger: Damn you type really slow. Are you horny by any chance?

messages.Ava: nah i type slow because i’m judging your energy and deciding if you’re worth the effort
